policyRules.rationale: Storage-account transport must require HTTPS. Review priority is not a CVSS score.

Valid applicable advisories without published classification block intake. Upstream severity remains unscored; HIGH is review priority, not CVSS. Exceptions remain exact per advisory/component/version/graph and capped at 30 days.
Preserve HTTPS-only transport for the exact supported AzAPI storage-account shape; unknown API versions do not inherit coverage.
Preserve the existing bootstrap state-storage TLS contract, only within the registered bootstrap role.
Bootstrap state storage retains Entra-oriented authentication with shared keys disabled; this does not impose that role on unrelated resources.
The exact bootstrap state-container role retains private blob access; this does not restrict intentional public telemetry ingress.
The bootstrap state-storage perimeter association remains Enforced. This check alone does not qualify its CIDRs, topology or identity relationships.
Generated Compose image references must exactly match the immutable supported-stack inventory; local builds must resolve to explicitly inventoried Dockerfiles, not remote or escaping contexts.

Valid native UNKNOWN with no same-record published score, vector or supported label remains blocking; HIGH is policy review priority, not CVSS. Exceptions require exact adopted image/component/version/advisory/digest identity and expire within 30 days.
Existing bootstrap state storage must remain SecuredByPerimeter with public blob access disabled; this rule does not restrict intentional public telemetry ingress.

Existing bootstrap perimeter admission requires an explicit nonempty IPv4 /32 list and inbound direction, without legacy subscription/service-tag admission. Unresolved bindings remain errors; representative fixtures are not operator values.

The exact declared bootstrap graph retains state-only perimeter/profile/container connections, storage-scoped Entra role assignment and existing deletion protections. Unknown resource membership or unresolved role bindings remain unqualified, not excepted by a resource count.

The exact telemetry role graph preserves its approved managed identity, least-privilege roles, HTTPS/public-ingress intent, digest reference, tokenless build source and six-column/180-day privacy contracts. Unknown role membership or malformed bindings remain unqualified; no production deployment or signing is claimed.
